title: Jesse Lee Peterson speaks on the fall of families and marriages‼️
cleanTitle: Jesse Lee Peterson speaks on the fall of families and marriages‼️
segments: How often did you see a black family
having kids out of wedlock? It was rare.
The boys were afraid. We were afraid to
make babies out of wedlock because we
would have to have a shotgun wedding. We
would have to get married. But what
happened if a girl did get pregnant? She
would have to leave town. Mhm. Because
it was an embarrassment for black women
to get pregnant out of wedlock. Less
than 10% of black baby born out of
wedlock without growing up. And if she
got pregnant and was not married, she
had to raise that baby. She would have
to drop out of school and everything and
raise her baby. And the women knew that
so they were less likely to have a baby.
How about abortions? What are they?
Unheard of. Unheard of. Unheard of.
Black people used to be amazing people
at one time, right? Really, I'm telling
you. And I never imagined that one day
it would get to this.
